dataVersion: Editorial wide-field viewpoint list v1 (2026-10-29); anchors and extents are approximations

viewpoints.noteZh: 银河最亮核心区，礁湖、三裂星云同段；入秋后只剩黄昏西南短窗。
viewpoints.noteEn: The brightest core of the Milky Way, with the Lagoon and Trifid in the same stretch; by late autumn only a short dusk window in the southwest remains.

viewpoints.noteZh: 夏季银河的一团亮云，野鸭星团 M11 在其北缘。
viewpoints.noteEn: A bright cloud of the summer Milky Way; the Wild Duck Cluster M11 sits at its northern edge.

viewpoints.noteZh: 北美洲星云与面纱星云同段，夏秋前半夜高悬。
viewpoints.noteEn: The North America and Veil Nebulae share this stretch, high in the first half of summer and autumn nights.

viewpoints.noteZh: 心脏、灵魂星云所在，秋冬北天高纬银河。
viewpoints.noteEn: Home to the Heart and Soul Nebulae — the high northern Milky Way of autumn and winter.

viewpoints.noteZh: 昴星团、加州星云一线，冬夜后半夜至黎明的主景。
viewpoints.noteEn: The Pleiades and California Nebula line — the main scene of winter nights after midnight.

viewpoints.noteZh: 玫瑰星云所在，冬季银河中段。
viewpoints.noteEn: The middle stretch of the winter Milky Way, holding the Rosette Nebula.

viewpoints.noteZh: 南天银河最亮段，煤袋与南十字在其内；北纬中纬度不可见。
viewpoints.noteEn: The brightest southern stretch, with the Coalsack and the Cross; invisible from mid-northern latitudes.
